description: This file is a shell script for testing GIT_CURL_VERBOSE behavior during git operations, setting up a repository, and capturing verbose curl output.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP daemon used for hosting the git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that may fail without failing the overall test suite.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
